title: Design System: Tikkun Reader Scroll Story

shadows.name: action-glow
shadows.purpose: Soft emphasis under filled actions that enter the reader.

shadows.name: reader-weight
shadows.purpose: Black weight and cool reflected light beneath the angled live reader.

shadows.name: paper-preview-lift
shadows.purpose: Ambient separation for the reader preview on the paper chapter.

shadows.name: playback-glow
shadows.purpose: A small glow around the two-pixel playback progress line.

motion.name: navigation-color
motion.purpose: Quiet color feedback on header links.

motion.name: action-state
motion.purpose: Hover and press feedback for filled actions and aliyah links.

motion.name: highlight-state
motion.purpose: Active Torah word color, background, and glow.

motion.name: sequence-settle
motion.purpose: Playback progress entering only with the listening beat.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Transition duration under prefers-reduced-motion; animations are disabled.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The dominant path from explanation into Torah practice.
components.css: .ds-primary-action { display: inline-flex; min-width: 12.5rem; min-height: 3.45rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 0; border-radius: 1rem; padding: 0.82rem 1.35rem; background: #3984ff; box-shadow: 0 1.25rem 3rem -1.8rem rgba(57, 132, 255, 0.88); color: #fff; font-family: 'Noto Sans Hebrew', sans-serif; font-size: 0.98rem; font-weight: 720; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-primary-action:hover { background: #4b90ff; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-primary-action:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-primary-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(95, 157, 255, 0.95); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Text Action
components.description: A low-emphasis path to explanation or coverage without another filled control.
components.css: .ds-text-action { display: inline-flex; min-height: 2.75rem; align-items: center; color: rgba(235, 240, 247, 0.82); font-family: 'Noto Sans Hebrew', sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; text-underline-offset: 0.28rem; } .ds-text-action:hover { color: #fff; } .ds-text-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(95, 157, 255, 0.95); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Header Navigation
components.description: A compact brand-and-links header that keeps the reader action present on every width.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-header { display: flex; min-height: 5rem; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; background: #06080b; color: #f6f7f9; font-family: 'Noto Sans Hebrew', sans-serif; } .ds-header-brand { display: grid; min-width: 0; gap: 0.14rem; color: #f6f7f9; text-decoration: none; } .ds-header-brand strong { font-size: 0.98rem; font-weight: 720; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-header-brand small { display: none; color: rgba(236, 240, 246, 0.68); font-size: 0.66rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-header-links { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1.25rem; } .ds-header-link { display: none; min-height: 2.75rem; align-items: center; color: rgba(236, 240, 246, 0.68); font-size: 0.84rem; text-decoration: none; transition: color 140ms ease; } .ds-header-link:hover { color: #f6f7f9; } .ds-header-open { display: inline-flex; min-height: 2.8rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 0.85rem; padding: 0.68rem 0.95rem; background: #3984ff; box-shadow: 0 1.25rem 3rem -1.8rem rgba(57, 132, 255, 0.88); color: #fff; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 720; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-header-open:hover { background: #4b90ff; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-header-open:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-header a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(95, 157, 255, 0.95); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (min-width: 34rem) { .ds-header-brand small { display: block; } } @media (min-width: 48rem) { .ds-header-link { display: inline-flex; } } @media (min-width: 64rem) { .ds-header { min-height: 6.25rem; } }

components.name: Live Reader Frame
components.description: The functional Beresheet proof, framed as a weighted object rather than a generic screenshot card.
components.html: Live Beresheet readerOpen full reader
components.css: .ds-reader-frame { overflow: hidden; border-radius: 1.1rem; background: #0b0e13; box-shadow: 0 3.2rem 7rem -3rem rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.96), 0 1.3rem 5rem -3rem rgba(65, 126, 241, 0.7); transform: perspective(90rem) rotateX(1deg) rotateY(-2.4deg) rotateZ(-0.65deg); transform-origin: center left; } .ds-reader-toolbar { display: flex; min-height: 3rem; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 0.8rem; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12); padding: 0.62rem 0.75rem 0.62rem 1rem; background: #11161d; color: rgba(245, 247, 250, 0.7); font-family: 'Noto Sans Hebrew', sans-serif; font-size: 0.72rem; } .ds-reader-toolbar a { display: flex; min-height: 2rem; align-items: center; gap: 0.35rem; color: #9fc2ff; font-weight: 680; text-decoration: none; } .ds-reader-toolbar a:hover { color: #fff; } .ds-reader-toolbar svg { width: 1rem; height: 1rem; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-width: 1.7; } .ds-reader-viewport { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 100 / 67; overflow: hidden; background: #e8e5dd; } .ds-reader-viewport::after { position: absolute; inset: 0; border: 3px solid rgba(95, 157, 255, 0.98); opacity: 0; content: ''; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity 120ms ease; } .ds-reader-viewport:focus-within::after { opacity: 1; } .ds-reader-viewport iframe { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; border: 0; background: #fff; } .ds-reader-toolbar a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(95, 157, 255, 0.95); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Theme Selector
components.description: A paper-surface segmented chooser controlling a live same-origin reader, with Light selected in this section only.
components.css: .ds-theme-selector { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid rgba(17, 18, 16, 0.18); border-radius: 0.95rem; background: #f6f5f1; } .ds-theme-selector button { display: grid; min-width: 0; min-height: 4.8rem; align-content: center; gap: 0.18rem; border: 0; border-right: 1px solid rgba(17, 18, 16, 0.16); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(17, 18, 16, 0.16); padding: 0.75rem 0.85rem; background: transparent; color: #111210; cursor: pointer; font-family: 'Noto Sans Hebrew', sans-serif; text-align: left; transition: background-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-theme-selector button:nth-child(2n) { border-right: 0; } .ds-theme-selector button:nth-last-child(-n + 2) { border-bottom: 0; } .ds-theme-selector button[aria-pressed='true'] { background: #10110f; color: #fff; } .ds-theme-selector button:hover:not([aria-pressed='true']) { background: rgba(17, 18, 16, 0.055); } .ds-theme-selector button:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-theme-selector button:focus-visible { position: relative; z-index: 1; outline: 3px solid #276fe6; outline-offset: -4px; } .ds-theme-selector strong { overflow: hidden; font-size: 0.9rem; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-theme-selector span { overflow: hidden; font-size: 0.68rem; line-height: 1.35; opacity: 0.72; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } @media (min-width: 48rem) { .ds-theme-selector { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); } .ds-theme-selector button, .ds-theme-selector button:nth-child(2n) { border-right: 1px solid rgba(17, 18, 16, 0.16); border-bottom: 0; } .ds-theme-selector button:last-child { border-right: 0; } }

components.name: Reading Row

components.css: .ds-reading-row { display: grid; gap: 1.25rem; border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12); padding: 1.6rem 0; background: #06080b; color: #f6f7f9; font-family: 'Lora', Georgia, serif; } .ds-reading-header, .ds-reading-bubbles, .ds-reading-open { display: flex; align-items: center; } .ds-reading-header { justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; } .ds-reading-title { min-width: 0; color: #f6f7f9; font-size: clamp(1.25rem, 5vw, 1.65rem); text-decoration: none; } .ds-reading-title:hover { color: #a9c9ff; } .ds-reading-title strong { font-weight: 400; } .ds-reading-status { color: rgba(236, 240, 246, 0.68); font-family: 'Noto Sans Hebrew', sans-serif; font-size: 0.7rem; } .ds-reading-bubbles { flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.45rem; } .ds-reading-bubbles a { display: inline-grid; width: 2.54rem; height: 2.54rem; place-items: center; border: 1px solid rgba(104, 196, 123, 0.48); border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(48, 116, 65, 0.58); color: #e8ffed; font-family: 'Noto Sans Hebrew', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-reading-open { width: fit-content; min-height: 2.75rem; color: #9fc2ff; font-family: 'Noto Sans Hebrew', sans-serif; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 680; text-underline-offset: 0.25rem; } .ds-reading-open:hover { color: #fff; } .ds-reading-row a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(95, 157, 255, 0.95); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (min-width: 48rem) { .ds-reading-row { grid-template-columns: minmax(13rem, 0.75fr) minmax(18rem, 1.25fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 2rem; padding: 1.75rem 0; } .ds-reading-bubbles { gap: 0.82rem; } .ds-reading-bubbles a { width: 2.7rem; height: 2.7rem; } .ds-reading-open { justify-self: end; } }

components.name: Aliyah Status Bubbles

components.html: אבג
components.css: .ds-aliyah-bubbles { display: flex; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.45rem; background: #06080b; } .ds-aliyah-bubble { display: inline-grid; width: 2.54rem; height: 2.54rem; place-items: center; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12); border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.045); color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4); font-family: 'Noto Sans Hebrew', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-aliyah-bubble.ds-cued { border-color: rgba(104, 196, 123, 0.48); background: rgba(48, 116, 65, 0.58); color: #e8ffed; } .ds-aliyah-bubble.ds-draft { border-color: rgba(91, 156, 255, 0.54); background: rgba(43, 93, 166, 0.68); color: #eff6ff; } .ds-aliyah-bubble.ds-missing { border-color: rgba(224, 184, 79, 0.58); background: rgba(133, 101, 20, 0.62); color: #fff4c5; } .ds-aliyah-bubble:hover { border-color: currentColor; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-aliyah-bubble:active { transform: translateY(0) scale(0.96); } .ds-aliyah-bubble:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(95, 157, 255, 0.95); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (min-width: 48rem) { .ds-aliyah-bubbles { gap: 0.82rem; } .ds-aliyah-bubble { width: 2.7rem; height: 2.7rem; } }

narrative.overview:
The scroll story is a near-black reading space in which practice never separates from the Torah page. Editorial Lora copy explains the workflow while a functional, angled Beresheet reader supplies the proof; blue actions lead into practice, and fine hairlines organize the story without turning it into a collection of feature cards.

The world stays restrained until one rounded white paper chapter introduces the reader themes, then returns to the dark readings index and its status-coded aliyah links. This record is scoped to the shipped isolated prototype: a user-pinned, preserve-led scroll story with seed key PINNED-SCROLL-STORY-2026-08-09, not a replacement for the public product design.
keyCharacteristics: A near-black reading space structured by fine light hairlines.
Lora editorial display type paired with Noto Sans Hebrew for controls.
Blue actions reserved for paths into practice and the live reader.
A clipped, angled Beresheet reader that remains functional.
One rounded white paper chapter with a second live reader, Light by default, before returning to readings.
Three product-real scroll scenes for contents, playback, and Continue.

rules.name: The Blue Path Rule
rules.body: Use Practice Blue for actions that open or advance practice; keep informational structure neutral.

rules.name: The One Paper Chapter Rule
rules.body: Reserve Paper for the theme chapter; the surrounding scroll story remains Reading Space.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Lora carries narrative explanation, while Noto Sans Hebrew carries controls, navigation, status, and metadata.

rules.name: The Text Is the Artifact Rule
rules.body: Use ShlomosemiStam only where the Torah text itself is being demonstrated.

rules.name: The Reader Leads Rule
rules.body: On wide screens, preserve the live reader's oversized right-edge crop instead of containing it beneath centered copy.

rules.name: The Proof Has Weight Rule
rules.body: Shadows lift the live reader, actionable progress, and paper preview only; ordinary content rows stay flat and divided by hairlines.

rules.name: The Circle Means Aliyah Rule
rules.body: Reserve circular controls for aliyah status links; actions and selectors remain rounded rectangles.

dos: Do keep practice copy and reader proof together in the first viewport.
Do use hairline borders to group sections and reading rows.
Do preserve circular aliyah links and their green, blue, and yellow status meanings.
Do let the white theme chapter act as the only major tonal interruption.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion by removing animations and shortening transitions.
donts: Don't replace the reader with generic feature cards or a detached transcript.
Don't spread paper surfaces throughout the dark story.
Don't use blue for decoration unrelated to reader or practice actions.
Don't flatten the desktop hero into centered copy above a contained screenshot.
Don't change theme controls into global reader preference writes.
